slides.title: What is Amnesty asking for in Alamata, Tigray?

slides.text: In a **Nov 23** report, Amnesty International calls for an **independent investigation** into artillery strikes on residential areas of **Alamata** on **Sept 26-28**.
Amnesty says **civilians were reported harmed** and attributes the shelling to **federal forces and Tigray forces**; the TPLF rejects the allegations.
Ethiopian authorities did not respond, according to news reports. Amnesty urges a **UN Human Rights Council** mechanism to examine the case.
**Protect civilians, back independent investigations.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Amnesty International, Nov 23, 2026; reported by AP/WaPo, Nov 25
